definition: A step of the house's journey that is finished: the brief stated, a candidate chosen, the plan drawn. It is drawn as a disc of vellum and says where the house has been, not whether it is any good.
basis: docs/ui-redesign-2026-10-29.md, the journey marks the redesign ruled for the sidebar and the front door: "Done = filled vellum disc / vellum tile". workbench/app/src/theme/tokens.css states the duty beside the token: "done is a vellum disc, the step in hand a gilt ring round a gilt dot".
